attributes.title: 2027 WNA APRN Pharmacology & Clinical Update
attributes.venue: Oneida Casino Hotel (formerly Radisson Hotel and Conference Center)
attributes.summary:
WNA has set the 2027 APRN update for April 8 to 10 at the Oneida Casino Hotel in Green Bay, moving from last year's Wisconsin Dells site. The 2027 hours and prices are not published yet. For a sense of scale only, the 2026 edition offered up to 17.5 contact hours, with pharmacology hours marked session by session.

That session-level marking matters: WNA leaves it to you to confirm that a session meets your own pharmacology requirement. WNA is approved as a provider through the Montana Nurses Association, an ANCC-accredited approver.
